counting_method: Count explicitly listed responsibility groups, not lines of code or a universal scalar complexity score. Grouping is disclosed; overlap is not a security guarantee. These counts describe proposed contracts, not production completeness.

trusted_authorities: Pinned Core implementation, canonical encoding and complete observable semantics
Pinned Safety extractor, original-property validator and Lean proof-checking toolchain with explicit native/model correspondence
Backend/export completeness and exact accepted boundary provenance
Explicitly trusted coordinator/host controls every actual writer and protects active module/policy/history
verification_obligations: Original property at complete activated boundary
Actual native exact transition and full subject continuity
Every-writer coverage, refusal handling and invalidation at module/policy/migration/restart boundaries
lifecycle_boundaries: Restart or loss of private authority
recovery_mechanisms: Fresh exact program and boundary establishment after loss
Retain original audit support without treating it as producer-independent authority
A.scope: Conditional segment argument and finite development integration. Frozen campaign blocked. Memory Q6 and adversarial-host independent prefix not established.

verification_obligations: Validate full typed packet and original identities
Public data/behavior replay plus independent request re-execution and every captured argument comparison
Original property at every claimed historical state
Own exact-parent evaluation/comparison/commit for resident continuation
recovery_mechanisms: Re-establish private checked Store from original material
Consume/discard basis on failed extension or changed subject
Explicit gap for trusted durable retained storage and unsupported migration histories
B.scope: Producer-independent actual-history checking in development, with replay and native correspondence assumptions. Not a separate Core interpreter, latest-head authority or Q6.

necessary: Exact semantic subject and complete observations

Reuse imported checked preservation/observation arguments under explicit bridges

Do not force equal latency budgets on certification, normal operation and onboarding without a product decision
